10 km

Accuracy. Every marker is placed from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, the GSI address register or the site's official page. Two positions are approximate (≈): Michi-no-Kawa (the prefecture describes it as a south-facing slope above the Otonashi near Mikoshi-tōge) and the seasonal Sennin-buro bath in the Ōtō riverbed. Solid Nakahechi lines are the mapped trail (OpenStreetMap Kumano Kodo relations, Takijiri–Hongū–Nachi). Dashed lines (Tanabe–Takijiri along the Tonda River, and the whole Ōhechi) follow the route's stations, passes and old roads by pedestrian routing, because no open survey of those alignments exists; they can stray from the footpath by a few hundred metres.

Terrain and coastline: GSI 10 m elevation model (出典：国土地理院). Trails, rivers and the Esumi–Sangodai motorway (under construction): © OpenStreetMap contributors.
